author: Retro Game Corps
description:
ASUS' latest eGPU solution is a big improvement over their previous model, with a universal TB5/USB4 connection, modern (laptop) GPU options, and a super compact shape and size.  But at this price point it feels a bit more like a solution that will be better in the future compared to today.

More info: https://rog.asus.com/us/external-graphic-docks/rog-xg-mobile-2025/

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
